about_the_game:
Best Trader: Trade Simulation is a realistic open-world simulation that combines trading, survival, and exploration.

You begin your journey in a small rural village, managing a modest fruit shop. Buy fruits at wholesale prices from the local market and sell them at fixed retail prices to earn your first profits. Product placement is automatic, letting you focus on expanding your business.

As you progress, opportunities grow. Beyond your starter shop, there are additional stores in the village and two more in the nearby city that you can purchase and operate. Visit the car dealership to buy a vehicle, making it easier to transport goods and explore the world around you.

But trade is only part of the story. The open world is filled with wildlife — hunt animals for food or profit, fish in rivers and lakes, or scavenge abandoned areas for valuable items. Survival is key: protect yourself from wolves and other predators, and prepare for terrifying encounters with zombies in dangerous zones. With a day–night cycle, dynamic exploration, and multiple paths to growth, every decision shapes your journey.

Key Features

Start small, grow big: begin with a fruit shop in a rural village and expand to multiple stores in the city.

Trading system: buy fruits at wholesale, sell at fixed prices, and manage multiple shops across the world.

Automatic product placement: shelves stock themselves, letting you focus on strategy and expansion.

Vehicle ownership: purchase cars to transport goods and unlock faster exploration.

Hunting & fishing: gather resources for survival or profit at the market.

Predators & zombies: defend yourself against wolves and survive zombie-infested areas.

Day–night cycle: experience a living world that changes over time.

Exploration & scavenging: discover hidden areas with valuable items for trade or consumption.

Best Trader: Trade Simulation blends economic simulation and survival mechanics in an open world full of danger and opportunity. Whether you focus on building a trading empire, surviving the wilderness, or exploring the unknown, the choice is yours.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 265 or equivalent (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 13 GB available space
  • Sound Card: any
  • VR Support: no
  • Additional Notes: Performance may vary depending on system configuration. Low settings are recommended for smoother experience on minimum hardware
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400F or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super / RTX 2060 or AMD RX 5600 XT (6GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: any
  • VR Support: no
  • Additional Notes: For optimal performance with medium to high settings in open world areas and dynamic AI behavior

short_description: Build and manage your own store, stock products, serve customers, and survive in a dynamic open world with hunting, fishing, hunger, thirst, and dangers like wild animals and zombies. Trade and survive in one immersive simulation.
supported_languages:
English*, Arabic, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Turkish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese
*languages with full audio support
